claim: AWS KMS HSMs were certified under FIPS 140-2 overall Security Level 2 continuously since 2017. Today all AWS KMS keys are protected by HSMs validated under FIPS 140-3 Security Level 3; FIPS 140-3 does not apply to AWS KMS in the China (Beijing) and China (Ningxia) Regions.

qualifiers.scope: AWS KMS HSMs outside the China (Beijing) and China (Ningxia) Regions

evidence.quote: AWS KMS HSMs have been certified under FIPS 140-2 overall Security Level 2 continuously since 2017.
All AWS KMS keys, regardless of their creation date or origin are automatically protected using HSMs that have been validated under FIPS 140-3 Security Level 3.

FIPS 140-3 does not apply to AWS KMS in the AWS China (Beijing) Region, operated by Sinnet and the AWS China (Ningxia) Region, operated by NWCD. The HSMs in China Regions are instead approved for use by the Chinese government.
